queries.query: ("large language model" OR LLM OR "language model") AND ("network configuration" OR "network-config" OR "device configuration" OR NetOps) AND (generate OR generation OR synthesis OR "intent to configuration" OR "intent-to-config")
queries.rationale: Directly retrieve papers that propose or evaluate LLMs for producing network device/configuration artifacts or intent→configuration translation.

queries.query: ("configuration repair" OR "config repair" OR "configuration synthesis" OR "configuration correction" OR "intent repair") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "language model" OR "generative model") AND (network OR NetOps OR router OR switch)
queries.rationale: Find work on LLM- or model-driven automated repair and correction of faulty network configs (repair/patch pipelines).

queries.query: ("generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-then-validate" OR "generate-then-check" OR "verify-and-repair" OR "loop" OR "closed-loop") AND (LLM OR "language model" OR agent OR "tool-augmented") AND (network OR NetOps OR AIOps)
queries.rationale: Locate architectures that pair generation with validation and iterative repair, especially tool-assisted LLM agents for NetOps.

queries.query: ("network configuration verification" OR "network verification" OR "header space analysis" OR NetKAT OR VeriFlow OR "model checking" OR "formal verification") AND (validation OR pre-change OR post-change OR "safety check")
queries.rationale: Collect classical and modern deterministic/ formal verification approaches used as validators or oracles for network configs (useful as mitigations/baselines).

queries.query: ("intent-driven networking" OR "intent aware" OR "intent based" OR "natural language" AND (network OR NetOps OR "network management")) AND (translation OR synthesis OR "intent to config" OR "intent to policy")
queries.rationale: Survey intent-driven NetOps literature and prior NL→config pipelines to position LLM contributions and gaps.

queries.query: ("AIOps" OR "NetOps automation" OR "automation in network operations" OR "autonomous network management") AND (reliability OR safety OR "operational trust" OR failure OR "failure modes")
queries.rationale: Locate AIOps and autonomous NetOps work focused on reliability, failure analysis, and operational safeguards to inform threats/mitigations.

queries.query: (hallucinat* OR "incorrect output" OR "bad config" OR "misconfiguration" OR "catastrophic error") AND (LLM OR "language model" OR "generative model") AND (automation OR NetOps OR "network operations")
queries.rationale: Target literature on LLM hallucinations and harmful/incorrect outputs in operational automation contexts; supports failure-mode analysis.

queries.query: ("controlled generation" OR guardrail* OR "constrained generation" OR "schema-constrained" OR "rule-based" OR "policy-guided") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (configuration OR NetOps OR network)
queries.rationale: Find methods that constrain or guard LLM outputs (rules, schemas, templates) applicable to safe NetOps generation.

queries.query: ("tool-augmented" OR "tool use" OR "agentic" OR ReAct OR Toolformer OR "planner-executor") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND ("network" OR "NetOps" OR AIOps)
queries.rationale: Identify agentic LLM patterns and tool-integration strategies (callable validators, simulators, CLIs) relevant to NetOps orchestration.

queries.query: ("benchmark" OR "evaluation" OR "dataset" OR "suite") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "networking questions" OR "network config") AND (limitations OR validity OR "threats to validity" OR reproducibility)
queries.rationale: Collect existing benchmarks for LLMs on networking tasks and critiques about benchmark validity to inform evaluation design and limitations.

queries.query: ("network change" OR "pre-change validation" OR "pre-deployment validation" OR "dry-run" OR "what-if") AND (verification OR validator OR simulator OR emulation) AND (router OR switch OR config)
queries.rationale: Find literature on pre-change validation and simulation/emulation environments used to test configurations before production deployment.

queries.query: ("human-in-the-loop" OR "human oversight" OR "operator-in-the-loop" OR "approval workflow") AND (LLM OR automation OR AIOps OR NetOps) AND (safety OR trust OR "operational decision")
queries.rationale: Gather studies of collaborative workflows that combine human operators and automated agents/LLMs to mitigate operational risk.

queries.query: ("software engineering" OR "code generation" OR "program synthesis" OR "specification-guided synthesis") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (verification OR test OR "synthesis validation")
queries.rationale: Pull in SE literature on LLM code generation and verification techniques that are methodologically transferrable to config generation and validation.

queries.query: ("dataset for NetOps" OR "NetOps benchmark" OR "networking benchmark" OR TSNBench OR "6G-Bench" OR OpsEval OR OWL) AND (description OR dataset OR evaluation OR limitations)
queries.rationale: Direct search for named/lead benchmark suites mentioned in the programme and critical analyses of their scope/limits.

inclusion_criteria: Works in English with clear bibliographic metadata (title, authors, venue/year, DOI/identifier).
Peer-reviewed publications (conference/journal) and archival preprints (arXiv) when primary and verifiable.
Papers addressing LLMs/generative models applied to network configuration, NetOps automation, AIOps, or closely related operational domains.
Methodological or empirical studies about verification, validation, testing, or guardrails for generated operational artifacts.
Benchmarks, datasets, or evaluation studies for LLMs on networking/AIOps tasks, including critiques of benchmark validity.
Foundational network verification/validation works (e.g., Header Space Analysis, NetKAT, VeriFlow) regardless of date.
Works describing tool-integration, agentic orchestration, or generate–validate–repair pipelines applicable to NetOps.
Resources (code/datasets) with public access links when available for reproducibility.
exclusion_criteria: Ungrounded marketing material, vendor whitepapers, or blog posts without primary experimental/methodological substance (unless they contain unique data or links to primary artifacts).
Non-English works without an accessible verified English translation or metadata.
Papers that only tangentially mention networks but focus on unrelated application domains without transferable methods.
Duplicate copies (mirror posts) where a primary peer-reviewed or archival record exists—prefer primary source.
Works lacking verifiable bibliographic metadata or stable identifiers.
Purely speculative opinion pieces without methods, experiments, or verifiable references.
date_rationale: Include foundational network-verification literature dating back (~2010+) to capture deterministic validators (e.g., Header Space Analysis, NetKAT), but emphasize 2018–2026 for LLM/generative-model and AIOps developments. The temporal window ensures coverage of Transformer-era methods (post-2017) and the rapid emergence of LLM tool/agent patterns (2022–2026), while retaining older verification/NetOps foundations needed for mitigations and validators.
